title: What are your thoughts on the Movies of Fountain, Black Swan and Mother? Is Darren Aronofsky a misogynist or in favor of women's right?

commenti.body: They are some of my favorite movies, and I believe he is genuinely, positively a feminist. I wrote about mother! recently in an article about caves, that it “features a secret cave. At one point, the “mother” fingers a red stain on her floor that opens into a hidden cave where she finds her secret power: fire. Caves also embody what feminist Elaine Showalter (1992) calls the “female wild zone.” It’s a place where women can harness and unleash their power.”
Ok but how do u justify that scene from fountain?

I think you’re committing too early to the symbolism. When he transcends the tree of life, he’s not only “getting over the death of his wife,” but also his immortality project. He’s embracing death, which catapults him into enlightenment/Life.
